WITH region AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON ((-84.790369 45.565387, -84.771372 45.565442, -84.771329 45.561553, -84.771561 45.551012, -84.771963 45.539986, -84.787355 45.539734, -84.797778 45.539563, -84.797082 45.55095, -84.79203 45.550957, -84.792015 45.558068, -84.79043 45.558067, -84.790392 45.564028, -84.79039 45.564396, -84.790369 45.565387))', 4326) AS g
),
buffered_region AS (
  SELECT
    g,
    ST_Buffer(g::geography, 100)::geometry AS g_buffer
  FROM region
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, r.g_buffer)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN buffered_region r
    ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.g_buffer)
),
slope AS (
  SELECT ST_Slope(rast, 1, '32BF', 'DEGREES', 111120) AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
),
region_slope AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(s.rast, r.g) AS rast
  FROM slope s, buffered_region r
)
SELECT (ST_SummaryStats(rast, 1, TRUE)).max AS slope
FROM region_slope;
